SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS phone, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.account_status AS accountStatus, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime, IFNULL(order_stat.order_count, 0) AS orderCount, IFNULL(order_stat.wait_pay_order_count, 0) AS waitPayOrderCount, IFNULL(order_stat.paid_order_count, 0) AS paidOrderCount, IFNULL(order_stat.total_pay_amount, 0) AS totalPayAmount, IFNULL(audience_stat.audience_count, 0) AS audienceCount, IFNULL(address_stat.address_count, 0) AS addressCount, IFNULL(want_stat.want_count, 0) AS wantCount FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'WAIT_PAY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wait_pay_order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('WAIT_USE', 'FINISHED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUND_SUCCESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_pay_amount FROM ticket_order GROUP BY user_id ) order_stat ON order_stat.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS audience_count FROM audience GROUP BY user_id ) audience_stat ON audience_stat.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM user_address GROUP BY user_id ) address_stat ON address_stat.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS want_count FROM want_record GROUP BY user_id ) want_stat ON want_stat.user_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS phone, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.account_status AS accountStatus, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime, IFNULL(order_stat.order_count, 0) AS orderCount, IFNULL(order_stat.paid_order_count, 0) AS paidOrderCount, IFNULL(order_stat.total_pay_amount, 0) AS totalPayAmount FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('WAIT_USE', 'FINISHED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUND_SUCCESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_pay_amount FROM ticket_order GROUP BY user_id ) order_stat ON order_stat.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
